item.title: Confetti at Noon: Families celebrate the New Year early at Wilmington Children’s Museum
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — Dozens of families gathered Wednesday at The Children’s Museum of Wilmington for its annual New Year’s Noon celebration. item.title: What to know about Trump administration freezing federal child care funds
item.description: The Trump administration has said it is freezing child care funds to all states until they provide more verification about the programs in a move fueled by a series of fraud schemes at Minnesota day care centers run by Somali residents.

item.title: Wall Street falls in light trading on the final day of 2025, another banner year for markets
item.description: Wall Street closed out another banner year for stocks Wednesday with a downbeat finish that extended the market’s recent losing streak to a fourth day. The S&P 500 gave up 0.7%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.6% and the Nasdaq composite closed 0.8% lower. Trading volume was very thin ahead of the New Year’s Day holiday, when markets will be closed, as most big investors have already closed out their positions for the year.
